checks.title: No secrets in tracked files
checks.detail: scanned 30 tracked text files against 10 credential shapes; none matched

checks.title: .gitignore covers secrets and generated binaries
checks.detail: all 5 required patterns present

checks.title: .env.example exists and holds no live values
checks.detail: 17 documented variables

checks.title: Configuration is env-var driven with no embedded defaults for secrets
checks.detail: config.py reads the environment (10 accessor calls) and require_env fails fast on an unset variable

checks.title: Logs redact credentials and never store raw queries
checks.detail: credentials and emails redacted in emitted records; queries appear only as salted digests (e.g. 6b0ac026ee75)

checks.title: No debug artefacts left in shipped code
checks.detail: no breakpoints, tracebacks-to-caller, or debug flags

checks.title: Resource ceilings refuse oversized allocations
checks.detail: all 5 allocation paths refuse above 22q (simulation) / 20q (enumeration)

checks.title: Untrusted input is validated, not trusted
checks.detail: 5 malformed inputs refused; zero-width and Unicode-Tags characters stripped before use

checks.title: Cache filenames cannot escape the cache directory
checks.detail: 6 traversal attempts all resolve inside cache/

checks.title: Indirect prompt injection is detected and spotlighted
checks.detail: 3/3 payloads flagged; context is numbered, delimited and preceded by a data-not-instructions preamble. Note: detection of *fluent* poisoning is 0% by design -- see SEC-11.

checks.title: Detector blind spot on fluent poisoning is measured, not hidden
checks.detail: instruction-injection 100% detected, topical-mimicry 0%. The second number is the honest one: fluent contradiction carries no pattern, so retrieval-level defence (QAOA redundancy) is what must be measured against it.

checks.title: No large binaries staged for git
checks.detail: 31 tracked files, 1.56 MB total; embeddings and corpora are regenerated, not committed

checks.title: Errors are typed and carry no internals to the caller
checks.detail: typed hierarchy under SecurityError; refusal message ('query is 99999 characters, limit is 2000'...) carries no path or traceback

checks.title: Runs are seeded and results are traceable to a config
checks.detail: 5 result file(s), every section seeded; each embeds the config or the commit that produced it

checks.title: Dependencies are pinned
checks.detail: all 17 requirements carry a version constraint

checks.title: Demo API hardening verified against live responses
checks.detail: 7 controls verified live: 6 headers present on a live response; /healthz returns status only; 2 explicit origin(s), no wildcard; valid body reaches the handler (503); size cap refuses 99KB with 413; field bounds refuse with 422; rate limit fires at the configured ceiling ([200, 200, 429, 429]); error bodies carry a correlation id and no internals

checks.title: Password hashing (bcrypt/argon2)
checks.detail: No user accounts exist. The pipeline has no authentication surface because it stores no user records and issues no sessions.

checks.title: IDOR / per-user authorisation on every route
checks.detail: There are no per-user resources. Every document in the corpus is public BEIR data with identical read permissions.

checks.title: Payment webhook signature verification
checks.detail: No payment or billing path.

checks.title: Server-side price recalculation
checks.detail: No commerce logic; nothing is priced.

checks.title: Row-level security / tenant isolation
checks.detail: Single-tenant research corpus, read-only, no database.

checks.title: Password-reset token lifetime and single use
checks.detail: No credential recovery flow, because there are no credentials.

checks.title: GDPR data-deletion request handling
checks.detail: No personal data is collected. Queries are held in memory for the duration of a request and recorded in logs only as salted digests, so there is no per-subject record to delete.

checks.title: Cookie flags (HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite)
checks.detail: The demo API is stateless and sets no cookies; it authenticates with a bearer token when QRAG_ENV=production.
